name: bilibiliweek
description: 涉及周刊哔哩哔哩排行榜制作相关的脚本

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:ps
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check generate.py history100.py history100_lost_info.py
scripts.lint:py:fix: uv run ruff check generate.py history100.py history100_lost_info.py --fix
scripts.lint:ps: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$results = @('download.ps1','makeyaml.ps1','normalize.ps1','favorite.ps1','fakerank.ps1') | ForEach-Object { Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $_ -Settings ./.vscode/PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 }; $results; if ($results | Where-Object Severity -eq 'Error') { exit 1 }"

author: Neutralized
